description: This source file defines API routes for managing PDF documents in a FastAPI web application. It provides endpoints for uploading PDFs (which are indexed for retrieval-augmented generation) and for listing the indexed documents. The code initializes a singleton pipeline object for processing PDF ingest and document listing, and responds with structured JSON including status, data, error details, and metadata.
